info.name: Indoor Navigation API
info.description:
Requests for every endpoint in docs/API.md, plus the five PRD 8.3 demonstration scenarios.

How to use
1. Start the backend with the demo seed (for example `docker compose up --build`).
2. Import this collection and `local.postman_environment.json`, then select the environment.
3. In the environment, set `adminPassword` to the administrator password whose BCrypt hash is in ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH. Never commit a real password.
4. Run the whole collection in order with the Collection Runner. "Admin > Sign in" stores a token that later admin requests use.

IDs are the fixed seed IDs from database/seed (Sample Mall is building 1). Requests that create obstacles delete them again, so the seed is left clean.

Owner: Person 2 (backend).
